partnershipPlan: Two residents from the June 2026 intake review the information sheet and the month-6 item before October; a preceptor and the union representative join the planning meeting; the human resources analyst confirms the extract steps.
socialListening: No social media listening; anonymous comments from the last two residency evaluations are read for mentions of the month-3 seminar.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If a low score goes to my manager, I will just write whatever looks fine.
items.implication: State on the information sheet that scores never reach managers.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: By the third month the orientation buddy is gone and the rota is full; that is when people start looking elsewhere.
items.implication: Keep the index test at month 3 and record seminar timing.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half the resignations we see in the system are nurses moving to another floor, not leaving us.
items.implication: Count transfers between units as staying.

items.theme: Support should not depend on a score
items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I would rather every new grad could ask for a mentor than wait to be picked by a questionnaire.
items.implication: Keep the booster open on request whatever the study shows.

summary: Four composite voices on labelling, timing, transfers and open access to support.
